text:
Sophie: Heads up — Gradient launch is next Tue. Want to run a 24h staggered bid-wave across Search + Retarget. Need final creative set + inbound routing for leads. Any blockers? :rocket:
Rafael: Love the idea. What's target CPA and primary geos? Also can we webhook leads to HubSpot?
Sophie: Target CPA ~$150. Primary: NA + UK (light AU). Yes webhook to HubSpot -> route demo requests to webinar SDR queue. @Michael can you confirm HubSpot field mappings?
Michael: Confirmed. I need final landing URLs and sample payload for form_id + utm. Also note we'll append gclid if present.
Ana: Creative status: 4 headlines, 3 desc lines, 2 hero images. My recommendation: rotate 6 initial variants first 6 hours, then promote top 2 for peak hours. Add a countdown element for webinar spots.
Jess: For Search budget I propose staged ramp: 10% baseline (launch hour), 40% mid-day, 100% peak for 3h block. Retarget: keep CPL cap but +20% bid for high-intent (visited pricing + 2+ pages). I'll configure in Ads.
Rafael: Can we run a UK canary for copy A vs B at 10% traffic? Want to validate CTA phrasing.
Sophie: Yes — UK + AU canaries at 10% each. Rest of traffic on main.
Ben: Analytics will publish benchmark dashboard. Need final creative IDs, landing URLs, and form names by EOD tomorrow to wire dashboards.
Jess: Also ad scheduling: pause after 10pm local timezone and exclude low-conv hours (2–6am).
Maria: Inbound routing plan: create SDR tag "gradient-webinar" and auto-assign to webinar queue. Hot leads (time_on_site > 5m && form_completed) should trigger a Slack ping to #sales-ping.
Michael: FYI tracking param updated to "src=gradient_launch_v2" — make sure UTM mapping matches.
Jess: I'll add the bid rules and a burnout guard. Rule snippet below:
```
name: gradient-bidwave
conditions:
  - hour_of_day in [12,13,14] # peak block UTC
  - geo in [US,CA,UK]
actions:
  - set_bid_multiplier: 1.0 -> 1.6
  - cap_cpa: 150
```
Ana: QA checklist (quick): 1) redirect & thank-you page ready 2) pixel fires on TY 3) HubSpot event mapping validated 4) UTMs preserved + gclid 5) countdown renders on mobile.
OpsBot: scheduled deploy window created for 2024-11-12T09:00:00Z (canary enabled).
Sophie: Drive folder with creatives + matrix: https://drive.redwood.com/gradient-creatives — please put final filenames there.
Ben: I'll wire the A/B test to analytics and set baseline KPIs (CTR, CVR, CPA by geo).
Jess: I'll post final Ads rule JSON here once drafted. Tagging @Ana for creative QA & @Michael for tracking payload.
Maria: Will set SDR auto-assign rules and create Slack workflow for #sales-ping.
Rafael: Quick ask — can we add a short survey on TY page to capture intent? 2 radio buttons (demo / pricing / not sure). That will help lead routing.
Sophie: Good call. Keep it 2 clicks.
Ana: Will add survey + ensure pixel maps answer keys.
Jess: I'll include time-of-day bid taper to avoid overdelivery after 3h peak.
Sophie: OK let's sync tomorrow 10am PT to confirm final assets. Thanks team :pray:
